card.name: Words meaning outside, above or beyond
card.fires_on: Words that mark a position away from or beyond something, such as south, out, above, below, and the start of extra- words. They come right before a word like of, ground, hepatic, or the cell.

modes.label: Direction or place words
modes.description: A direction or position word (south, out, above, below) that points to a place beyond a boundary or surface.
